tool_args.rationale: Eight paid observations span the sink-gradient range and show no chaotic sign oscillations. Fit the four-parameter barrier/siphon response plus one horizon-scaled memory-versus-state lag coefficient. The module-level fit state is set by fit(), so confirmation calls to predict() use the estimated parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the resulting eight observations cover broad input and sink-gradient ranges, so another batch is not presently justified.
It is irrelevant to resolving the smooth five-parameter barrier-plus-lag hypothesis and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
The recalled signatures and gradient-dependent suppression favor a barrier/siphon response over either alternative, and the coupled transient-lag signature calls for an additional fitted lag term.
